text:
alex: Quick sync — we need to lock final launch criteria for the Dedicated reserved pools autoscale behavior. Specifically: what triggers an autoscale up, how soft quotas behave during spikes, and oncall playbook for SLA breaches. Can owners volunteer?

maria: where are we on the telemetry signals? we need reliable indicators before we put this in prod.

sam: we have tail-latency, queue-length, and GPU-util. current plan maps:
- scale-up if avg queue > 80% for 30s OR p95 latency > 500ms for 60s
- scale-down if queue < 20% for 5m

priya: those thresholds look reasonable as a starting point. propose we add a soft-quota mode that returns 429 for non-critical tenants and routes to hosted fallback for critical ones. that will limit noisy neighbors while keeping SLAs for paid tiers.

jamal: billing + contract note: we can't silently preempt dedicated capacity for enterprise customers. if we fallback them to hosted, we need a flag in the tenant profile and explicit consent in the contract. otherwise we should prefer model-variant fallback (quantized or smaller model) over routing off dedicated.

alex: agreed. two-tier fallback: 1) model-variant on same pool (quantized local) 2) hosted region fallback (only for tenants who opted in). fallbacks should be opt-in for enterprise.

maria: ops question — how visible is this to SRE? need alerting and a runbook. can we generate per-tenant token-level metrics + alert on error-rate increase and avg latency?

sam: yes. metrics we can emit immediately: dedicated_pool.{tenant}.q_len, .p95_lat, .preempt_count, .fallback_count. suggest alert when .fallback_count > 0 for >1m for a paying customer.

priya: launch gating idea: require 2 canary customers on the new autoscale policy for 2 weeks, zero regression on p95, and a documented runbook tested by oncall. also add a dark-run where fallback_count increments but doesn't actually route until we flip the flag.

jamal: canary customers — we should pick 1 low-risk and 1 medium-risk (higher QPS) to validate both tails. Ops should have a throttling override to force scale-up manually during test windows.

alex: propose owners: sam (metrics + runtime hooks), priya (policy config + rollout), maria (observability & alerts), jamal (contracts + billing). can we each confirm?

sam: ack. i'll add flags and the config schema. snippet:
```json
{
  "autoscale": {
    "scale_up": {"q_threshold_pct": 80, "duration_s": 30, "p95_ms": 500, "p95_duration_s": 60},
    "scale_down": {"q_threshold_pct": 20, "duration_s": 300}
  },
  "fallback": {"order": ["model_variant","hosted"], "hosted_opt_in": true}
}
```

priya: ack. i'll draft rollout steps: staging dark-run -> canary1 -> canary2 -> GA. add a config toggle per-tenant: `autoscale_mode: conservative|balanced|aggressive`. conservative disables soft-fallback, aggressive favors quicker scale-up.

maria: ack, i'll create dashboards and an alert doc. question: what SLO breach action do we want? auto-scale + page on critical customer fallback?

jamal: page on critical fallback or >5% error-rate sustained 3m. billing team wants an automated billing flag if we do more than X host-fallback minutes per month (so we can reconcile credits).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled deploy for autoscale runtime hooks at 2230013000 — will run canary-stage only.

alex: next steps I will: 1) capture this as the launch criteria doc 2) priya to own rollout plan 3) sam to land metrics/hooks 4) maria to own alerts/dashboard 5) jamal to draft contract opt-in wording. target: dark-run in 2w, canary in 4w.

priya: one more: include a graceful degradation rule — if scale-up fails and fallback not opted-in, respond with best-effort token limiting (token-shed 20%) and header `x-degraded: true` to help clients apply client-side retry/backoff.

sam: added. we'll emit `degrade_reason` in logs too.

maria: i'll add an Ops playbook section: how to revert autoscale policy, how to kill canary, and how to manually route a tenant off dedicated. will link runbook in the doc.

jamal: I'll circulate a short amendment for enterprise agreements for opt-in to hosted fallback plus credits policy.

alex: perfect. meeting adjourned. tagging follow-ups: @sam @priya @maria @jamal — please drop PR links here when ready. :thumbsup:
